product_metadata.title: JERIA 6-Pack Extra Large Capacity Storage Bins with Clear Window, Closet Organizer and Clothes Storage Bags, Reinforced Handle and Sturdy Zipper (Grey)
features: UPGRADE MATERIAL: The organizer is made from high-quality, three-ply non-woven fabric

STURDY ZIPPER: Equipped with #5 stainless steel zippers which are hard to be broken, and can be used for a longer period of time. And two-way zippers allow it to easily slide along the closure when in use, regardless of how full the bag is
PACKAGE:6 Sets of fabric storage bag/Bin, Perfect for storing and protecting seasonal clothing, blankets, bedding, toy, holiday decorations and etc
EASY TRANSPORT: Two handles and lightweight material make moving easily. Clear window see through what are stored inside the bin
SIZE: 24" L X 16" W X 14" H, The size fits in various spaces in bedroom, college dorm, basement, attic, or more. Storage bags save space and can be folded when not in use
